title: Took me more than 6 hours to put together
text:
Took me more than 6 hours to put together. The holes for the screws are not aligned correctly, took me the whole freaking night to make holes by hand (I don't have a drill)! The drawer was driving me crazy the holes were so off, I couldn't even close the drawer. Took me forever to measure the exact point where the holes should be. My hands are so painful now after holding the screwdriver for so long and push screws into the wood by force.

The manual says there is a pack of "K" screws, but I couldn't find it. I could still skip that and put it together without the K pack. For those who are looking for the missing pack, you don't need it.

Otherwise it's pretty. Low price too.
